title: Motorcycle LED Turn Signals 4-Pack – Micro Amber 12V
descriptionHtml:
Be clearly seen in traffic

Tiny or broken turn signals mean other road users can't see when you turn. Clear turn signals are a simple but important safety detail.

Bright LED turn signals in a 4-pack

These turn signals have bright amber-glowing LEDs and come in a 4-pack. They are small and stylish and fit most 12V motorcycles.

Features

  • Bright amber LED light
  • 4-pack – front and rear
  • Small and stylish
  • Fits 12V
  • Universal for most motorcycles

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
